title: Two years packaging the thruster into grounded enclosures

tellings.quote: So, after Drew and I did these experiments in 2016, uh I think we spent about two years trying to package it.

plain: After a set of experiments in Florida in 2016 on a thruster meant to push without fuel, an engineer named Charles Buhler says he and a colleague named Andrew Arjima spent about two years, up to around 2018, trying to package the device into grounded casings. Buhler, presented on the show as a figure from the US space agency NASA, tells Michels this as someone who did the work, as part of his claim that they built a working propulsion system that does not rely on ordinary thrust.
